messages.subject: WC-00106 Hale - settlement position
messages.plaintextBody:
Edward, Karen,

Ashworth Quinn are pushing for £125,000 ex gratia plus a £1,500 legal contribution and outplacement. My recommendation is to counter at £115,000 ex gratia, agree outplacement (capped at £5,000) and offer £750 plus VAT towards fees. Total cost to the Company including the PILON and holiday would be around £214,600 gross, plus employer NIC. Are you content for me to proceed on that basis?

Kind regards,
Tom Gallagher
Associate

Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0000
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
